user_saw: In Slack sessions with /reasoning stream on and Slack streaming off, the Gateway pegged its main thread during long reasoning streams, with multi-second event-loop stalls and replies arriving many minutes late.
summary: Slack's pushReasoningProgress returns early when no preview can show reasoning, skipping the quadratic re-merge of accumulated reasoning text.
reasoning: GraphQL blame puts the non-progress-mode merge block in pushReasoningProgress at 64daf8dd239 (a July 2026 split refactor that moved older code), and no commit after September touched those lines; the wasted per-delta re-merge was always there but harmless for short streams. It became a visible stall only with hour-long, megabyte-scale reasoning streams from newer models, a data-growth trigger rather than a specific in-repo change.
